Installed after a wartime delay (foundry trust)

tiers.everyday: Great George is a 15-tonne bell at Liverpool Cathedral, which also has the highest and heaviest peal of ringing bells in the world.
tiers.student: The cathedral gives Great George as 15 tonnes and 2.9 m across; the 13-bell ring totals about 17 tonnes with a 4.06 t tenor, which it calls the highest and heaviest peal. The Taylor foundry trust (reference) gives casting in 1940 and installation in 1951.
